article.title: Sprinklr開放六款行銷AI代理beta，涵蓋創意、執行與合規覆核
article.title_en: Sprinklr opens a six-agent marketing beta spanning creative, execution and compliance
article.summary: Sprinklr於10月27日開放Marketing AI Agents beta，列出構思、創意、活動執行、合規、社群及預算優化六款代理，強調策略與審批仍由人負責。
article.summary_en: Sprinklr opened its Marketing AI Agents beta on October 27, naming agents for ideation, creative, campaign execution, compliance, community and budget optimization, with people retaining strategy and approvals.
article.why: 對需要跨市場改稿與上稿的大型團隊，可評估代理能否減少交接工作。重點是核對品牌背景與審批鏈，避免將更快製作等同更好成效。
article.why_en: Enterprise teams can assess handoffs across localization and activation while retaining brand context and approval ownership. Faster production alone does not establish better results.
article.next_step: 向帳戶團隊申請beta資訊，先以一份既有brief檢查市場、語言、素材與合規例外的交接。
article.next_step_en: Ask the account team about the beta and evaluate one existing brief for market, language, asset and compliance handoffs.
highlights: Creative Agent協助編輯、變體、本地化及A/B測試，主要延伸已批准的概念與素材。
Campaign Execution Agent可將媒體brief轉成活動、受眾及素材，並連接推出前合規檢查。
有意參與beta的客戶需聯絡帳戶團隊。
highlights_en: Creative Agent supports editing, variations, localization and A/B testing of approved ideas and assets.
Campaign Execution Agent translates briefs into campaigns, audiences and creative and connects to pre-launch compliance checks.
Customers interested in the beta are directed to their account team.
article.detail:
Sprinklr於10月27日開放Marketing AI Agents beta，列出構思、創意、活動執行、合規、社群及預算優化六款代理，強調策略與審批仍由人負責。

Creative Agent協助編輯、變體、本地化及A/B測試，主要延伸已批准的概念與素材。

Campaign Execution Agent可將媒體brief轉成活動、受眾及素材，並連接推出前合規檢查。

有意參與beta的客戶需聯絡帳戶團隊。

對需要跨市場改稿與上稿的大型團隊，可評估代理能否減少交接工作。重點是核對品牌背景與審批鏈，避免將更快製作等同更好成效。

向帳戶團隊申請beta資訊，先以一份既有brief檢查市場、語言、素材與合規例外的交接。

公告未提供正式全面推出日期或經獨立驗證的成效；合規代理不能取代法律或品牌負責人的判斷。
article.detail_en:
Sprinklr opened its Marketing AI Agents beta on October 27, naming agents for ideation, creative, campaign execution, compliance, community and budget optimization, with people retaining strategy and approvals.

Creative Agent supports editing, variations, localization and A/B testing of approved ideas and assets.

Campaign Execution Agent translates briefs into campaigns, audiences and creative and connects to pre-launch compliance checks.

Customers interested in the beta are directed to their account team.

Enterprise teams can assess handoffs across localization and activation while retaining brand context and approval ownership. Faster production alone does not establish better results.

Ask the account team about the beta and evaluate one existing brief for market, language, asset and compliance handoffs.

The release provides no general-availability date or independently validated results. A compliance agent does not replace legal or brand judgment.
